facts.fact: The NICI-III plan (published 2011) records among Rwanda's achievements the enactment of Law Nº 18/2010 of 12 May 2010 governing electronic messages, electronic signatures and electronic transactions, along with data protection, cyber security and ICT use in government procedures.
facts.system: Law Nº 18/2010 governing electronic messages, electronic signatures and electronic transactions

systems.system: Law Nº 18/2010 governing electronic messages, electronic signatures and electronic transactions

note: The plan also lists, as a future action, developing regulations enforcing the electronic transaction law; a plan, not a rule made.
